lead: Attachments in a chat: images / videos are thumbnail tiles (name and size shown on hover), everything else is a horizontal file card with a colored icon showing the extension. Attachments waiting to be sent in the composer can get a remove button.

media.title: Images and video
media.description: An image / video with `src` is a thumbnail; its name and size overlay the bottom on hover or focus. Without `src` it falls back to a file card.

api.title: API Reference
api.group: A row of attachments that wraps; a `div` with `role=group`.
api.kind: Infers the file kind (pdf / archive / sheet / doc / code / audio / video / image / file) from the MIME type, then the extension
api.size: Formats a size in bytes: 12 B / 3.4 KB / 1.2 MB

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: Root; `data-variant` (`media` thumbnail / `file` card), `data-kind` (the file kind, decides the icon color)
styling.preview: The preview: thumbnail or file icon
styling.media: The image / video inside a thumbnail
styling.icon: The file icon (shows the extension, colored by kind)
styling.info: Name and size; on a thumbnail they overlay the bottom on hover / focus
styling.remove: The remove button; on a thumbnail shown only on hover / focus, always on touch screens
